name: @local/poemfilm
description: 古诗视频分镜、素材生成和本机剪辑工具与 DSH Skill

scripts.build: npm run check && node scripts/runtime.mjs setup
scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node --check scripts/runtime.mjs && sh -n bin/poemfilm
scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.mjs && uv run --frozen --extra agent --extra test python -m pytest -q tests
